faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How does Orderly unify front of house and back of house?
faq.a1: Instead of running separate software for kitchen display, POS terminals, and management dashboards, Orderly provides a single role-aware frontend connected to YARP API Gateway microservices.
faq.q2: How does live WebSocket sync operate across devices?
faq.a2: Orderly connects all active browser clients to a SignalR hub with automatic back-off reconnection (1s, 2s, 5s, 10s, 30s). State changes push instantly without client polling.
faq.q3: What security measures govern role access?
faq.a3: Authentication uses short-lived in-memory JWT access tokens combined with secure httpOnly refresh cookies. All zone routes are guarded by layout-level role predicates.
faq.q4: Can Orderly scale to multi-location restaurant chains?
faq.a4: Yes. The backend microservices architecture decouples Identity, Catalog, Order, Basket, Discount, Kitchen, and Notification domains for maximum throughput and horizontal scalability.
